title: Offline Learning Portal
description: Offline Learning Portal v1.1.0 is a Windows school LAN resource portal for locally hosting and organising authorised educational materials. NGINX serves the portal and its resources; NSSM manages the Windows service. Includes interactive installation and removal, a searchable local catalogue, catalogue-generation tools, bundled NGINX/NSSM components with third-party notices, and three illustrated beginner guides (4, 10 and 10 pages). Optional Kiwix/ZIM hosting is documented but not bundled. The project owner reports Windows testing passed; validation and test-history files record scope and evidence. Original project files use MIT; third-party components and school-added resources retain their own terms. Creator/contact: Tirtharaj Dhungana, tirtharajdhungana84@gmail.com. Zenodo DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23131009.
